* '''Original''' (this page): text as given in the Virtual Block 7.4 release sheet, titled •Cyborg Commander's Lightsabers<ref name="sheet-VirtualBlock7_4">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock7_4.pdf Virtual Block 7.4 release sheet] ("Official text as of December 16, 2011"; PDF dated 19 December 2011, the same file the Players Committee site offered in February 2012). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261020174533/https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock7_4.pdf Internet Archive]</ref>: “Deploy on Cyborg Commander. May add 1 to Force drain where present. May target a character or creature for free. Draw two destiny. Target hit, and may not satisfy attrition (or be removed from Lost Pile this turn), if total destiny > defense value.” The release-sheet slip ([[:File:VB7-01-Grievous_Lightsabers.png]]) prints it. The PC website card list (in every capture from 21 July 2012 to 11 January 2013, as “Cyborg Commander's Lightsabers”) showed the same text<ref name="cl-1274_11-2012-07-21">Players Committee website card list (VBlock7Type), as captured [https://web.archive.org/web/20120721064742/http://www.starwarsccg.org:80/cardlists/VBlock7Type.html 2012-07-21] (Internet Archive); same text in every capture to [https://web.archive.org/web/20130111152155/http://www.starwarsccg.org:80/cardlists/VBlock7Type.html 2013-01-11]</ref>.
* '''PC-E1''' ([[Grievous' Lightsabers (V)]]): the Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (official text as of 27 April 2013) titles the card •Grievous' Lightsabers and reads “Deploy on Grievous”<ref name="ml-ds">[[Media:Virtual_Legacy_Final_Master_DS.pdf|Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (Dark Side)]], cover "official text as of April 27, 2013" (PDF built February 2014). Original: http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterDS.pdf. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20170704232650/http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterDS.pdf Internet Archive]</ref>: “Deploy on Grievous. May add 1 to Force drain where present. May target a character or creature for free. Draw two destiny. Target hit, and may not satisfy attrition (or be removed from Lost Pile this turn), if total destiny > defense value.” The Players Committee had announced the persona change “Cyborg Commander ---&gt; Grievous” on 29 January 2013.<ref name="persona-2013">[https://web.archive.org/web/20130221003512/http://www.starwarsccg.org/index.php?option=com_content&view=article&id=350&catid=1&Itemid=117 New Persona Changes], [[Players Committee]], 29 January 2013 (“Cyborg Commander ---&gt; Grievous”). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20130221003512/http://www.starwarsccg.org/index.php?option=com_content&view=article&id=350&catid=1&Itemid=117 Internet Archive]</ref> The Master List slip ([[:File:VL-history-1274-11-front-master.png]]) and the Players Committee card image ([[:File:VB7-D-grievouslightsabers-pre.gif]]) print it.
